verdict.rationale: The evidence pack cites Google's Discovery document for Drive v3 (googleapis.com/discovery/v1/apis/drive/v3/rest), a machine-readable JSON API description that is an equivalent of OpenAPI. The content quoted from it, such as OAuth scope descriptions, shows it is publicly fetchable. The probe found no OpenAPI file at generic developers.google.com paths, but those were guessed locations and do not contradict the Discovery spec's existence. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly describing the Discovery doc as a downloadable spec, a native OpenAPI-format file, and independent or hands-on corroboration of tooling use.
